models_evaluated: machine learning survival probability and ventilator length-of-use models

links.outcome: Racial disparity in access to the ventilator priority queue under three prioritization schemes
links.effect: ISP-LU yields a Pareto-improvement over SOFA-P and ISP in saved lives while limiting racial disparity in access to the priority queue; no numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: We also show that ISP-LU is a robust priority scheme whose implementation yields a Pareto-improvement over both SOFA-P and ISP in terms of maximizing saved lives after mechanical ventilation while limiting racial disparity in access to the priority queue.

unlisted_practices: Using ML-predicted survival probability per ventilator length-of-use, rather than SOFA scores, to prioritize scarce ventilator allocation

screen.reason: Evaluates ML-driven predictive risk models plugged into simulated priority queueing schemes for scarce ventilator allocation, assessing outcomes and racial equity across allocation policies.
